shared_elements: incised linear carving on a flat stone panel
justification: A depicts a bearded human figure in profile with elaborate headdress, robe and a long spear held vertically, rendered in low relief with naturalistic drapery folds; B depicts no figures at all, only horizontal ruled bands of inscribed letters above a symmetrical foliate cross-shaped ornament with scrolling tendrils. The only correspondence is the generic fact of shallow incised linear decoration on a flat rectangular panel, which is far too universal to suggest a shared iconographic tradition.
